stages.name: from
stages.summary: Picks the Brokers to read. Always the first line.

forms.does: Every connected Broker.
One Broker, by its name.
Several Brokers.

stages.details: A Pipeline never reads Derived Topics, so it can't feed itself.

stages.name: filter
stages.summary: Keeps a value only if a condition holds.

forms.does: A jq condition on the current value. Anything but false and null keeps it.
The original topic matches any of the MQTT filters: + is one level, # is the rest.
The original topic matches none of them.
Names a wildcard: + or # followed by a name. From here on $room is the level + matched, and $rest the levels # matched (null for none).

stages.details: Put `filter topic` first: Preview uses the leading ones to pick its sample messages. A named wildcard matches like a plain one; with several filters, a name the matching one lacks is null.

stages.name: map
stages.summary: Replaces the value with the result of a jq expression.

forms.does: The new value.

stages.details: An expression with several results sends each on as its own value; one with no results drops the value.

stages.name: changes
stages.summary: Passes a value only when it differs from the previous one.

forms.does: Compared per original topic.
Compared per key, a jq expression: for example two sensors that report one room.

stages.name: throttle
stages.summary: At most one value per interval; the latest wins.

forms.does: Per original topic.
Per key, a jq expression.

stages.details: The first value passes at once. Later ones wait, and when the interval is up the latest of them goes on.

stages.name: debounce
stages.summary: Sends the latest value once there has been no new one for a while.

forms.does: Per original topic.
Per key, a jq expression.

stages.details: Good for chatty sensors: you get the value they settle on.

stages.name: scan
stages.summary: Carries a result from value to value, and sends each new result.

forms.does: In the update, `.` is the new value and `$acc` the previous result (the start, the first time). What it gives is the next result.
A result per key instead of per topic.

stages.details: The start is one value: 0, null, {}, or anything longer in ( ).

stages.name: window
stages.summary: Collects values and sends them as a list when the window closes.

forms.does: On the clock: `window 1m` closes at every whole minute.
Every N values.
A window per key; `$key` says which.

stages.details: Shape the list with map and the list functions, like `map { room: $key, avg: avg(.temp) }`. Empty windows send nothing.

stages.name: take
stages.summary: Passes the first values and no more.

forms.does: The first N values; then the Pipeline finishes.
The first N per key; the Pipeline keeps running.

stages.name: inspect
stages.summary: Shows the value in the output panel and passes it on unchanged.

forms.does: Labelled with the original topic.
With your own label.

stages.name: to
stages.summary: Sends the value to a Sink and passes it on.

forms.does: A Derived Topic in the Topic Tree, under Pipelines ▸ <this Pipeline> ▸ <topic>.

Republishes on a connected Broker, QoS 0 and not retained. A topic the Pipeline would read back is refused: narrow what it reads with filter topic right after from. Copies that come back anyway, through another Broker Profile for the same Broker, are left out and counted as came back.

stages.details: Strings are sent as text; anything else as JSON. Use {…} in the topic to fill in values. Preview shows what to broker would send without sending it.

variables.name: $payload
variables.does: The original payload: parsed JSON, or a string when it isn't JSON. `.` starts as this and changes with map.

variables.name: $levels
variables.does: The topic split at /: $levels[0] is the first level.

variables.name: $connection
variables.does: The name of the Broker the message came from.

variables.name: $time
variables.does: When it arrived, in seconds since 1970 (with decimals). `$time | todate` gives a date.

variables.name: $qos
variables.does: The QoS it arrived with: 0, 1 or 2.

variables.name: $properties
variables.does: MQTT 5 properties, or null: contentType, responseTopic, correlationData, messageExpiryInterval, payloadFormatIndicator, userProperties (a list of [key, value]).

variables.name: $key
variables.does: What the latest Stage that keeps state (changes, throttle, debounce, scan, window, take … by) kept the value under: the `by` value, or the topic. null before any.

syntax.does: The current value. `.temperature` is a field of it, `.a.b` a nested one, `.list[0]` an item.

syntax.name: { a: .x, b: .y, }
syntax.does: An object. It may span several lines and end with a comma.
Joins Stages. A new line before it is usual, but not needed.
A comment, to the end of the line.
Fills in a value in any string: "{.temp} °C", "hot/{$levels[2]}". Write {{ and }} for literal braces.
Inside an expression, jq's own pipe: `.name | ascii_downcase`.

syntax.name: a // b
syntax.does: a, or b when a is null or false: `.temp // .temperature`.

functions.name: length
functions.does: Items in a list, keys in an object, characters in a string.

functions.name: keys
functions.does: An object's keys, sorted.

functions.name: has
functions.does: Whether an object has a key.

functions.name: select
functions.does: Keeps the value if the condition holds, else no result.

functions.name: map
functions.does: jq's map: applies to each item of a list (not the Stage).

functions.name: tostring
functions.does: Any value as a string.

functions.name: tonumber
functions.does: A string as a number.

functions.name: round
functions.does: Rounds to the nearest whole number.

functions.name: floor
functions.does: Rounds down.

functions.name: ceil
functions.does: Rounds up.

functions.name: min
functions.does: The smallest item of a list. `min(.t)` gives the smallest .t in a list of objects.

functions.name: max
functions.does: The largest item of a list. `max(.t)` gives the largest .t in a list of objects.

functions.name: add
functions.does: Adds up a list (numbers, strings or lists).

functions.name: avg
functions.does: The average of something over a list, such as a window; null for an empty list.

functions.name: sum
functions.does: The total of something over a list.

functions.name: count
functions.does: How many items a list has; the same as length.

functions.name: sort
functions.does: Sorts a list.

functions.name: sort_by
functions.does: Sorts a list by a key.

functions.name: unique
functions.does: Sorted, without duplicates.

functions.name: first
functions.does: The first item of a list.

functions.name: last
functions.does: The last item of a list.

functions.name: startswith
functions.does: Whether a string starts with another.

functions.name: endswith
functions.does: Whether a string ends with another.

functions.name: test
functions.does: Whether a string matches a regular expression.

functions.name: split
functions.does: Splits a string.

functions.name: join
functions.does: Joins a list of strings.

functions.name: ltrimstr
functions.does: Removes a prefix, if there.

functions.name: rtrimstr
functions.does: Removes a suffix, if there.

functions.name: ascii_downcase
functions.does: Lower case.

functions.name: ascii_upcase
functions.does: Upper case.

functions.name: to_entries
functions.does: An object as a list of {key, value}.

functions.name: with_entries
functions.does: Changes each {key, value} of an object.

functions.name: del
functions.does: Removes a field.

functions.name: type
functions.does: "null", "boolean", "number", "string", "array" or "object".

functions.name: tojson
functions.does: A value as a JSON string.

functions.name: fromjson
functions.does: Parses a JSON string.

functions.name: todate
functions.does: Seconds since 1970 as an ISO 8601 date.

functions.name: now
functions.does: The current time, in seconds since 1970.

functions.name: not
functions.does: true for false and null, else false.

functions.name: empty
functions.does: No result: in map, drops the value.
